items.source: SubscriptionRequest implementation to be used to listen to query results in a Capped Collection using a Tailable Cursor.

items.source: Lookup the given SubscriptionRequest within the container and return the associated Subscription if present.
items.translation: 在容器中查找给定的SubscriptionRequest，如果存在则返回其关联的Subscription。
